profile.summary:
I'm a full stack web developer with a passion to help people live easier and better lives through innovation and technology. 

With an empathetic personality and background in chemical engineering and startups, I strive to create responsive & efficient applications with excellent user experience. I bring a strong work ethic, clear communication, open-mindedness, and compassionate teamwork to whatever I do. 

Technologies: 
• JavaScript 
• React.js
• Redux
• Python
• Ruby 
• Ruby on Rails
• HTML
• CSS
• SQL
• Git/GitHub

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
D-Shape is a 3D printing company that specializes in using stereolithography to create large stone-like structures.

I was in charge of gathering and presenting as much information about cements through databases, online searches, videos, and phone calls. The reason behind this was to ensure this method of "printing"​ cement would be as effective as today's methods/practices. Hence, strengths, weaknesses, curing times, durability, and many other factors were looked into. I also did a side project and looked into PLA, a 3D printing material, and how carburetor cleaner caused a change in its texture.

honors.title: 3rd Place - TigerLaunch Startup Competition
honors.description: TigerLaunch is a national collegiate entrepreneurship competition hosted annually by the Princeton Entrepreneurship Club in partnership with universities across the country like NYU, USC, University of Chicago, etc. It is a 5-month long competition split across three stages: an online video pitch round in December, a regional competition in March, and finally Demo Day in April. Ephemeral took 3rd place winning $5,000 in prize money.

honors.title: 1st Place NYU Technology Venture Competition
honors.description:
The NYU Technology Venture Competition serves as a catalyst for the creation of new and the acceleration of existing early stage businesses based on technologies developed by NYU students, faculty and researchers.

Sponsored by the NYU Entrepreneurial Institute, the competition awards a total of $75,000 in cash prizes, plus pro bono services and technical assistance to the winners.
honors.issuer: Issued by NYU Stern School of Business · May 2015

projects.title: Inkspiration
projects.description:
Platform for tattoo artists & users where they can explore & upload tattoo sketches and edit them to their preference

• Fully integrated React/Redux frontend with Rails backend and PostgreSQL database
• Utilized Cloudinary service, and React-DropZone and SuperAgent libraries to store images upon upload
• Added b-crypt authentication & JWT token to secure application’s communication with REST API

projects.title: Weather Pew
projects.description:
A weather application where you can search forecasts around the globe and save your favorite cities to your homepage

• Managed aesthetics of application using vanilla CSS3 (grid & flex) & font incorporation 
• Constructed the backend foundation (database schema, MVC) using Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL 
• Successfully made AJAX requests from Weatherbit API in respective React components
